The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained an '''embassy''' in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and it was functioning during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The embassy had an elevator leading to an underground [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] safehouse, and at some point during the conflict, a Republic representative [[Fauler]], who was secretly an agent of the SIS, used the safehouse for staging his [[SIS operation on Tatooine|covert operation]] to uncover the mystery behind [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]'s old [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research complex]], located in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Timely Arrival">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
